title: Fase 03 — Optimización de assets (gallinazo + favicons + OG images dinámicos)
description: Optimización de assets visuales antes del deploy. Mascota gallinazo (solo logo y favicon, por restricción de marca), set completo de favicons, y generación de OG images dinámicos para previews sociales (clave dado el enfoque SSG-first). Bloqueante para deploy. Migrado desde GSD (.planning/ROADMAP fase 03).
acceptance_criteria: Logo y favicon del gallinazo optimizados (uso restringido a logo/favicon por marca)
Set de favicons completo (multi-tamaño + apple-touch + manifest)
OG images dinámicos por página/reseña para previews sociales
Assets servidos optimizados (formato/compresión) sin romper el SSG

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DONE. Commits 4513047 (og helper) + 236e1d0 (assets + per-page OG) on main. Independent review PASS, no HIGH/MEDIUM.

- Gallinazo source (5.8MB) moved to brand/gallinazo-source.png (out of public/, never ships); scripts/gen-assets.mjs (npm run assets, uses sharp + png-to-ico) generates the optimized set into public/: favicon 16/32, favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon 180, android-chrome 192/512, logo-72.png (header), og-default.png (1200x630 branded). site.webmanifest added; index.html head updated; App.vue logo repointed. dist no longer contains any multi-MB gallinazo (largest image now og-default.png 381KB).
- Dynamic OG via @unhead/vue rendered by vite-ssg: App.vue sets site-wide defaults (og/twitter, summary_large_image), per-page useHead overrides. ResenaDetail (previously had NO head) now sets title/description/og:image from resena.imagen (Sanity transform w=1200&h=630&fit=crop) with og-default fallback; HuecaDetail extended (og:image from fotos[0]); home og:url. New pure helper src/lib/og.ts (ogImageUrl/absoluteUrl), 9 unit tests.
- Build verified: reseña page bakes exactly one og:image = Sanity CDN URL w/ transform; imagen-less reseña + non-content pages fall back to absolute og-default.png; no duplicate/empty meta. 61 tests green, typecheck clean.

HANDOFF to TASK-015: og:url/og:image-fallback bake the site base URL at SSG time. VITE_SITE_URL defaults to https://ecuahuecas.web.app; set the real domain in CI and rebuild. Optional: bundle a font for deterministic OG-card regeneration (committed PNG is fine as-is).
